s.note: Prawn on cucumber, honey ricotta toasts, figs wrapped in prosciutto
s.how: Top cucumber rounds with 200g cooked prawns and lemon mayo. Toast baguette slices and top with ricotta whipped with honey. Wrap 6 halved figs in 100g prosciutto. Serve on silver trays.

s.n: Bunk bed parmesan garlic butter popcorn
s.note: Did we just become best friends? Garlic butter and parmesan.
s.how: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large pot with a lid, add 150g popping corn, cover and shake over medium heat until the popping slows. Melt 60g butter with a crushed garlic clove. Toss the popcorn with the garlic butter, 40g finely grated parmesan, cracked pepper, fine salt and chopped parsley. Split between two big bowls.

m.note: Snapper roasted with lemon, garlic and capers, herb buttered new potatoes
m.how: Boil 800g new potatoes for 15 minutes and toss with 30g butter and chopped parsley and dill. Lay 4 snapper fillets in a dish with lemon slices, 2 sliced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp capers and 3 tbsp olive oil. Roast at 200C for 12 minutes. Whisk 1 tsp Dijon, 1 tbsp white wine vinegar and 3 tbsp olive oil and toss with a bag of mixed leaves.

w.note: Vanilla and chocolate ice cream with hot fudge, whipped cream, sprinkles, cherries
w.how: Put tubs of vanilla and chocolate ice cream on ice. Melt 150g dark chocolate into 150ml cream for hot fudge. Set out sprinkles, 200ml whipped cream and cherries so everyone builds their own.

d.n: Catalina Wine Mixer strawberry rosé spritz
d.note: Dry rosé over pressed strawberries and elderflower, topped up and served over ice
d.how: Slice 8 strawberries and divide between four large wine glasses. Add 15ml elderflower cordial and a squeeze of lemon to each and press lightly with a spoon. Fill with ice, pour in 120ml cold dry rosé and top with 60ml soda water. Stir gently and add a lemon wheel.
